name: Run SSH command
description: Run a command line on a remote host over SSH and return its output and exit code

command.description: Command line to run on the remote host

host.description: Run on this host instead of the account's host. It must be listed in the account's allowed hosts (case-insensitive)

timeout.description: Maximum execution time, in seconds (from 1 to 3600)

fail_on_error.description: Mark the action as failed when the exit code is not 0

host_key_fingerprint.description: SHA256 fingerprint of the server's host key
